'''Michael Lierheimer''' was a Decipher-era [[Squadron Members|Squadron Member]], listed as Red 102 from Langenbach, Ger. The published fan table marks the slot Retired after Decipher's SWCCG run.

He played from the release in 1995, became a tournament director in 1998 and a Squadron Member in 1999.<ref name="decsq-prof" />

Decipher recruited volunteer Squadron Members in the 1990s to promote SWCCG locally (tournaments, demos, player support). "FL" is printed on some slots in the surviving tables; the tables do not spell out the abbreviation.
